findings.message: May throw IllegalStateException. For some inputs this code throws IllegalStateException, so it can fail at runtime.
`parts` may be out of range. `parts` changes on each loop pass, and nothing shows what it holds there.
`parts` may be out of range. `parts` changes on each loop pass, and nothing shows what it holds there.
`entry.getValue().size()` may be negative. `entry.getValue().size()` changes on each loop pass, and nothing shows what it holds there.
`parts` may be out of range. `parts` is a call's result, and nothing shows what that call returns.
`parts` may be out of range. `parts` is a call's result, and nothing shows what that call returns.
`clauses` may not hold what it must. `clauses` is read from a field, and nothing shows what it holds.
`file.getName()` may be out of range. `file.getName()` changes on each loop pass, and nothing shows what it holds there.
What `getAnnotation` returns can be null here. `getAnnotation` can return nothing in ordinary conditions, and its answer is used without a check, so the first member access throws.
A failure is caught and cannot be reported. The failure is caught and nothing is returned, so callers get the same value whether the work failed or succeeded. The work is silently lost.
A failure is caught and cannot be reported. The failure is caught and nothing is returned, so callers get the same value whether the work failed or succeeded. The work is silently lost.
A request to stop is caught and ignored. The handler catches the cancellation signal and carries on, so cancelled work runs to the end. Whoever asked it to stop cannot tell that it did not.
